name: Greater Psychomachy (Psionic)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Psychomachy*, one or more metapsionic feats.

Benefit(s): Whenever you use the Psychomachy metapsionic feat, you may expend 4 additional power points to deal damage to a second mental ability score of your choice.
